017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.json5;
018
019import java.io.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.marshall.json.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.stream.*;
024
025/**
026 * Reference implementation of the public {@link TokenReader} surface for the JSON5 format.
027 *
028 * <p>
029 * Subclasses {@link JsonTokenReader} to add the JSON5 dialect's relaxations:
030 * <ul>
031 *    <li>Strings can be single-quoted, double-quoted, or unquoted bare identifiers.
032 *    <li>Field names can be single-quoted, double-quoted, or unquoted bare identifiers.
033 *    <li>Trailing commas before <c>]</c> / <c>}</c> are allowed.
034 *    <li>Missing values in arrays / objects emit {@link TokenType#VALUE_NULL}.
035 *          <li>JavaScript comments (<c>//</c> line, <c>/* &#42;/</c> block) are tolerated &mdash; already
036 *       accepted by the parent class.
037 *    <li>JSON5 numbers: leading <c>+</c>, leading/trailing decimal points, hexadecimal, {@code Infinity}/{@code NaN}.
038 *    <li>String line-continuation (backslash + line terminator is omitted from the value).
039 * </ul>
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * The cursor is a true O(1)-memory streaming cursor ({@link #isStreaming()} == <jk>true</jk>).
043 *
044 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
045 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe.
046 *    <li>The cursor is purely structural; object swaps and {@code @Schema} annotations have no
047 *       effect.  Use the POJO databind path on {@link Json5Parser} for those.
048 * </ul>
049 */
050@SuppressWarnings({
051   "resource" // The cursor's underlying ParserPipe is owned by the caller via try-with-resources on the cursor itself; Eclipse JDT flags the inner pipe as unclosed but that's by design.
052})
053public class Json5TokenReader extends JsonTokenReader {
054
055   /**
056    * Constructor with default settings.
057    *
058    * @param pipe The parser input pipe to read from.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
059    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying reader.
060    */
061   public Json5TokenReader(ParserPipe pipe) throws IOException {
062      super(pipe);
063   }
064
065   /**
066    * Constructor used by {@link Json5ParserSession#readTokens(Object)} to plumb the calling
067    * session through so that {@link #read(Class)} can delegate to the JSON5 databind path.
068    *
069    * @param pipe The parser input pipe to read from.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
070    * @param settings The cursor-level settings.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
071    * @param session The {@link Json5ParserSession} for {@link #read(Class)} delegation, or
072    *    <jk>null</jk> to disable {@code read}.
073    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying reader.
074    */
075   public Json5TokenReader(ParserPipe pipe, Settings settings, Json5ParserSession session) throws IOException {
076      super(pipe, settings, session);
077   }
078
079   // =================================================================================
080   // JSON5 dialect relaxations
081   // =================================================================================
082
083   @Override /* JsonTokenReader */
084   protected boolean allowsTrailingComma() {
085      return true;
086   }
087
088   @Override /* JsonTokenReader */
089   protected void readNumberValue() throws IOException, ParseException {
090      var s = Json5ParserSession.readJson5NumberLexeme(r);
091      if (s.isEmpty())
092         throw parseException("Invalid JSON5 number: '%s'", s);
093      currentNumberLexeme = s;
094      currentToken = TokenType.VALUE_NUMBER;
095   }
096
097   @Override /* TokenReader */
098   public Number getNumber() throws ParseException {
099      if (currentToken != TokenType.VALUE_NUMBER)
100         throw new IllegalStateException("Current token is not VALUE_NUMBER (was " + currentToken + ")");
101      return Json5ParserSession.parseJson5Number(currentNumberLexeme, null);
102   }
103
104   @Override /* JsonTokenReader */
105   protected void readValueStart(int c) throws IOException, ParseException {
106      // Missing-value: a leading comma or container-end at value position emits VALUE_NULL and
107      // re-injects the structural char so the next state transition picks it up.
108      if (c == ',' || c == ']' || c == '}') {
109         r.unread();
110         currentToken = TokenType.VALUE_NULL;
111         afterValue();
112         return;
113      }
114      // Single-quoted strings (JSON5).
115      if (c == '\'') {
116         r.unread();
117         currentString = maybeTrimString(readString());
118         currentToken = TokenType.VALUE_STRING;
119         afterValue();
120         return;
121      }
122      // JSON5 numbers that JSON itself would not start: leading '+', leading '.', Infinity, NaN.
123      if (c == '+' || c == '.') {
124         r.unread();
125         readNumberValue();
126         afterValue();
127         return;
128      }
129      // Bare identifier as a string value (e.g. `[foo, bar]` -> ["foo", "bar"]).
130      if (isBareStart(c)) {
131         r.unread();
132         // Bare identifiers might also be the keyword literals true/false/null — distinguish.
133         var word = readBareWord();
134         switch (word) {
135            case "true":  currentBoolean = true;  currentToken = TokenType.VALUE_BOOLEAN; afterValue(); return;
136            case "false": currentBoolean = false; currentToken = TokenType.VALUE_BOOLEAN; afterValue(); return;
137            case "null":  currentToken = TokenType.VALUE_NULL; afterValue(); return;
138            case "Infinity", "NaN":
139               currentNumberLexeme = word;
140               currentToken = TokenType.VALUE_NUMBER;
141               afterValue();
142               return;
143            default:
144               currentString = maybeTrimString(word);
145               currentToken = TokenType.VALUE_STRING;
146               afterValue();
147               return;
148         }
149      }
150      super.readValueStart(c);
151   }
152
153   @Override /* JsonTokenReader */
154   protected void readFieldNameOrEndObject(int c) throws IOException, ParseException {
155      if (c == '}') {
156         popContainer();
157         currentToken = TokenType.END_OBJECT;
158         afterValue();
159         return;
160      }
161      // Single-quoted field name.
162      if (c == '\'') {
163         r.unread();
164         currentFieldName = maybeTrimString(readString());
165         currentToken = TokenType.FIELD_NAME;
166         state = S02_expectColon;
167         return;
168      }
169      // Bare identifier field name.
170      if (isBareStart(c)) {
171         r.unread();
172         currentFieldName = maybeTrimString(readBareWord());
173         currentToken = TokenType.FIELD_NAME;
174         state = S02_expectColon;
175         return;
176      }
177      super.readFieldNameOrEndObject(c);
178   }
179
180   @Override /* JsonTokenReader */
181   protected void readCommaOrEndArray(int c) throws IOException, ParseException {
182      if (c == ']') {
183         popContainer();
184         currentToken = TokenType.END_ARRAY;
185         afterValue();
186         return;
187      }
188      if (c != ',')
189         throw parseException("Expected , or ] but got '%s'", (char) c);
190      var c2 = readSkipWsAndComments();
191      if (c2 == -1)
192         throw parseException("Unexpected end of input after ','");
193      // JSON5 trailing comma: `[1,]` is legal — `]` here closes the array.
194      if (c2 == ']') {
195         popContainer();
196         currentToken = TokenType.END_ARRAY;
197         afterValue();
198         return;
199      }
200      state = S00_expectValue;
201      readValueStart(c2);
202   }
203
204   @Override /* JsonTokenReader */
205   protected void readCommaOrEndObject(int c) throws IOException, ParseException {
206      if (c == '}') {
207         popContainer();
208         currentToken = TokenType.END_OBJECT;
209         afterValue();
210         return;
211      }
212      if (c != ',')
213         throw parseException("Expected , or } but got '%s'", (char) c);
214      var c2 = readSkipWsAndComments();
215      if (c2 == -1)
216         throw parseException("Unexpected end of input after ','");
217      // JSON5 trailing comma: `{a:1,}` is legal — `}` here closes the object.
218      if (c2 == '}') {
219         popContainer();
220         currentToken = TokenType.END_OBJECT;
221         afterValue();
222         return;
223      }
224      state = S01_expectFieldName;
225      readFieldNameOrEndObject(c2);
226   }
227
228   @Override /* JsonTokenReader */
229   @SuppressWarnings({
230      "java:S2677", // r.read() consumes the already-peeked '\n' of a CRLF line continuation; cannot hit EOF.
231      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for JSON5 quoted-string escape-handling state machine.
232   })
233   protected String readString() throws IOException, ParseException {
234      // JSON5 strings may be single- or double-quoted, and a backslash before a line
235      // terminator is a line-continuation (the terminator is omitted from the value).
236      r.mark();
237      var qc = r.read();
238      if (qc != '"' && qc != '\'')
239         throw parseException("Did not find quote character marking beginning of string");
240      String s = null;
241      var inEscape = false;
242      var c = 0;
243      while (c != -1) {
244         c = r.read();
245         if (inEscape) {
246            switch (c) {
247               case 'n': r.replace('\n'); break;
248               case 'r': r.replace('\r'); break;
249               case 't': r.replace('\t'); break;
250               case 'f': r.replace('\f'); break;
251               case 'b': r.replace('\b'); break;
252               case '\\': r.replace('\\'); break;
253               case '/': r.replace('/'); break;
254               case '\'': r.replace('\''); break;
255               case '"': r.replace('"'); break;
256               case '\n':
257                  r.delete();
258                  break;
259               case '\r':
260                  r.delete();
261                  if (r.peek() == '\n') {
262                     r.read();
263                     r.delete();
264                  }
265                  break;
266               case 'u': {
267                  var hex = r.read(4);
268                  try {
269                     r.replace(Integer.parseInt(hex, 16), 6);
270                  } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e) {
271                     throw parseException("Invalid Unicode escape sequence in string");
272                  }
273                  break;
274               }
275               default:
276                  throw parseException("Invalid escape sequence in string");
277            }
278            inEscape = false;
279         } else {
280            if (c <= 0x1F && c != -1)
281               throw parseException("Unescaped control character encountered: '0x%s'", String.format("%04X", c));
282            if (c == '\\') {
283               inEscape = true;
284               r.delete();
285            } else if (c == qc) {
286               s = r.getMarked(1, -1);
287               break;
288            }
289         }
290      }
291      if (s == null)
292         throw parseException("Unterminated string");
293      return s;
294   }
295
296   private String readBareWord() throws IOException, ParseException {
297      // The leading char was already validated via isBareStart(); since every bare-start char is
298      // also a valid bare-continuation char, the loop consumes it on the first iteration.
299      r.mark();
300      while (true) {
301         var c = r.read();
302         if (c == -1 || !isBareCont(c)) {
303            if (c != -1) r.unread();
304            return r.getMarked();
305         }
306      }
307   }
308
309   private static boolean isBareStart(int c) {
310      return Character.isLetter(c) || c == '_' || c == '$';
311   }
312
313   private static boolean isBareCont(int c) {
314      return Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '_' || c == '$';
315   }
316
317   // Local trim helper — the parent's maybeTrim is private and not visible to this subclass.
318   private String maybeTrimString(String s) {
319      if (s == null || !settings.trimStrings())
320         return s;
321      return s.trim();
322   }
323}
